items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: And then this young kid, Dud Bascomb?

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, I forgot his name now --
he is in California now. I can't remember. And then this young kid, Dud Bascomb? (Wilbur Bascomb -- ed.)
Dud Bascomb, Doug Baskin, yeah. His father's name was Doug Baskin also. What band was he in?
